text:
alex: Hey folks — need a quick swap. My flight got pushed to Sunday AM, I can't cover oncall 07:30–11:30. Can someone take the early block? Sorry for the short notice :grimacing:

riley: I can probably do 08:00–11:30, but I'm tied up until 08:00. Is there anything high-risk morning-wise?

sam: I can pick up 07:30–09:30 and then hand to riley at 09.0 if that helps. I can shadow the last 30min for handback.

alex: Amazing, thank you. Main risk window is the nightly batch warmup + a small canary rollout at 08:15 that sometimes spikes KV cache misses. No active incidents.

maya: Quick handoff notes (copying runbook):
- prewarm check: run `curl -s https://metrics/internal/kvcache | jq .miss_rate` (target < 0.02)
- if miss spike, restart prefix-cache service: `kubectl -n inference rollout restart deploy/prefix-cache`
- canary rollback: in console -> Deployments -> canary -> rollback -> confirm

sam: Thanks @maya. Can you paste the short checklist I should follow if I take the first 2 hours?

maya: Sure — pasteable checklist:
1) Check prewarm metric above
2) Validate model pool health: `rdwl pool status --model=gptx-small`
3) Confirm dedicated nodes >= 2 in us-west-2
4) Keep eye on alerts: `#alerts` channel for `cache-miss` and `inference-latency`
5) If anything odd, page oncall-sre and ping slack thread

riley: Good plan. I'll take 09:00–11:30 handoff from sam. Sam — can you DM me your phone in case I need the immediate context?

sam: Yep sending now. Also will drop a short runbook snippet in this thread after I've verified prewarm.

sam: Verified prewarm at 07:25 — miss_rate 0.008, pool healthy. Leaving a note: "prewarm ok, starting morning canary at 08:15, monitor for spikes."

oncall-bot: Reminder set: 07:10 — run prewarm checks.

alex: You all are lifesavers, thank you. I'll be reachable on flight (limited) but handed to sam then riley as planned. I'll update calendar to reflect swap. :pray:

riley: Got it, I'll take the last window. If anyone wants to pair for the canary at 08:15, I'm available 08:10–08:20 to watch metrics with you.

maya: I'll be around 08:00–08:30 to help if needed.

sam: Handback to riley at 09:00 complete. Leaving runbook note: "handed to riley — watch canary for 10m post-deploy."

riley: Took over at 09:00. Thanks @sam. I'll post any anomalies here.

alex: Updated calendar and tagged recovery steps in the shift event. Appreciate everyone. :thumbsup:
